instruction: For each product in all three zones, find the maximum quarterly sales value (across Q1, Q2, Q3, and Q4) and enter it in the Total column

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding the maximum value among Q1-Q4 for each product and filling it in column F. Verified with Python: F3=max(4142,4867,3072,2370)=4867, F4=max(2122,2014,3167,3478)=3478, F5=max(3799,1343,4026,1923)=4026, etc. All 9 product maximums computed and verified. Custom getter reads cells F3-F19, custom metric compares with expected maximums.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly reads the Total column cells (F3-F19) where maximum values should be entered, matching instruction requirements
Metric logic properly compares actual cell values with expected maximum values using tolerance-based numeric comparison
Expected values are semantically correct - each value is the actual maximum of Q1-Q4 for that product (verified in metadata explanation)
Complete coverage - evaluator checks all 9 products across all 3 zones (3 products × 3 zones = 9 cells)
Proper postconfig present to activate window and save file (Ctrl+S) before reading, ensuring fresh data
Correct parameter handling - metric receives rules dict directly when expected.type='rule', and correctly accesses 'cell_values' key
Data flow is correct - getter returns Dict[cell_addr, value] and metric expects the same structure
Appropriate tolerance (0.1) for numeric comparisons handles floating-point precision
Edge cases handled - getter returns {} for missing files, metric handles None values gracefully
